# pantechdynamics_object_storage_key (Resource)

An S3 access key for the organization's buckets (object storage, closed beta). Use access_key_id and secret_access_key with any S3 tool at endpoint. The secret is returned only when the key is created, so it lives in Terraform state: keep state somewhere safe. Keys cannot change; every argument replaces the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An access key for the application, limited to one bucket. Its secret is
# shown only when the key is created, so it is kept in Terraform state: treat
# the state as a secret. Keys cannot change: changing any argument issues a
# new key.
resource "pantechdynamics_object_storage_key" "app" {
  name    = "app"
  buckets = [pantechdynamics_bucket.uploads.name]
}

# A read-only key for every bucket in the organization.
resource "pantechdynamics_object_storage_key" "reader" {
  name      = "backup-reader"
  read_only = true
}

# AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for any S3 tool, at endpoint.
output "app_access_key_id" {
  value = pantechdynamics_object_storage_key.app.access_key_id
}

output "app_secret_access_key" {
  value     = pantechdynamics_object_storage_key.app.secret_access_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name such as "app", unique in the organization, at most 64 characters. Changing it replaces the key.

### Optional

- `buckets` (Set of String) Bucket names the key may use. Leave it out for every bucket in the organization. Changing it replaces the key.
- `read_only` (Boolean) The key may read but not write or delete. Defaults to false. Changing it replaces the key.
- `region` (String) Region code, such as "af-abj". Leave it out for the default region. Changing it replaces the key.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String) The S3 access key id.
- `created_at` (String) When the key was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `endpoint` (String) The S3 endpoint URL for the key's region, from the create response. Null after an import.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the key, starting with osk_.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The S3 secret access key. The API shows it only in the create response, so it exists only in Terraform state. It is null after an import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A key is imported by its id. Its secret cannot be read back, so
# secret_access_key is null after an import; replace the key to have
# Terraform hold a secret.
terraform import pantechdynamics_object_storage_key.app osk_06ggf6abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
